title: RepGen: Reproducing Deep Learning Bugs through Context-Aware Code Generation and Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reproducing deep learning (DL) bugs is challenging because failures can involve source code, models, data, dependencies, and execution environments. Incomplete bug reports further complicate reproduction by omitting essential details. We present RepGen, an open-source tool for reproducing DL bugs through context-aware code generation and iterative verification. Given a bug report and repository, RepGen explores the codebase to build a learning-enhanced context, develop a reproduction plan, and generate candidate scripts. It refines candidates using static checks and LLM feedback to improve their correctness and relevance. When enabled, the tool prepares the execution environment, runs the script, and assesses its output against the reported failure. RepGen provides an interactive command-line interface supporting local and hosted LLMs, configurable execution budgets, and inspectable artifacts, along with a GitHub Action for automated iss

translated_title: RepGen：通过上下文感知的代码生成与验证复现深度学习缺陷
translated_abstract: 复现深度学习（DL）缺陷极具挑战性，因为故障可能涉及源代码、模型、数据、依赖项和执行环境，而不完整的缺陷报告因遗漏关键细节进一步增加了复现难度。我们提出了 RepGen，这是一个通过上下文感知代码生成与迭代验证来复现深度学习缺陷的开源工具。给定一份缺陷报告和代码仓库，RepGen 会探索代码库以构建学习增强的上下文，制定复现计划，并生成候选脚本。它利用静态检查和大语言模型（LLM）反馈来改进候选脚本，从而提升其正确性与相关性。在启用相应功能时，该工具会准备执行环境、运行脚本，并将输出与报告的故障进行对比评估。RepGen 提供交互式命令行界面，支持本地和托管的大语言模型、可配置的执行预算以及可查看的产物，并附带用于自动化议题处理的 GitHub Action。
tldr: RepGen 是一个开源工具，通过探索代码库构建上下文、生成候选复现脚本，并利用静态检查与大语言模型反馈进行迭代验证，从而在缺陷报告不完整的情况下自动复现深度学习缺陷。
en_tdlr: RepGen is an open-source tool that automatically reproduces deep learning bugs by exploring the codebase to build context, generating candidate scripts, and iteratively refining them through static checks and LLM feedback, even when bug reports are incomplete.
